regions.name: Fife
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops in Fife | Granite Systems, Kirkcaldy
regions.description: Granite, quartz, Dekton and marble worktops made in our Kirkcaldy factory and fitted across Fife by our own team. Free quotes.
regions.h1: Stone worktops, made and fitted in Fife
regions.lede: Granite, quartz, Dekton, marble and Corian, templated digitally, cut in our Kirkcaldy factory and fitted by our own team.
regions.local: Our factory is on the Randolph Industrial Estate in Kirkcaldy, so for Fife customers we're never far away. You're welcome to come in and see the materials, and the team who cut your worktop are the same people who template and fit it. If you're nearby, ask about our offcuts too: they're ideal for hearths, tabletops and smaller pieces.

regions.name: Edinburgh & the Lothians
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Edinburgh & Lothians | Granite Systems
regions.description: Bespoke granite, quartz and Dekton worktops for Edinburgh, Midlothian, East and West Lothian. Templated, made and fitted by our own team.
regions.h1: Stone worktops for Edinburgh & the Lothians
regions.lede: Kitchen worktops, vanities and bar tops in granite, quartz and Dekton, made in our Fife factory and fitted across Edinburgh and the Lothians.
regions.local: We're just over the Queensferry Crossing in Kirkcaldy, so Edinburgh and the Lothians are well within reach of our templating and fitting teams. We work with homeowners directly and with kitchen studios and builders, from city flats to new builds. Every worktop is measured digitally on site, so there's no mess, no board templates and an accurate fit.

regions.h1: Stone worktops for Dundee, Perth & Tayside
regions.lede: Granite, quartz and Dekton worktops for kitchens, bathrooms and bars in Dundee, Perth, Angus and Perthshire, made in Fife and fitted by our own team.
regions.local: From Kirkcaldy it's a straight run up the M90 to Perth or over the Tay to Dundee. Whether it's a family kitchen in Broughty Ferry, a farmhouse in Perthshire or a hotel bar in Angus, we handle the whole job (measuring, manufacture and fitting) with one point of contact from start to finish.

regions.lede: Granite, quartz and Dekton worktops for Stirling, Falkirk and Clackmannanshire, made in our Fife factory and fitted by our own team.

We template, make and fit for homeowners, kitchen showrooms and developers across Stirling, Falkirk and Clackmannanshire, and we're as happy cutting a single vanity top as fitting out a full development.
